title: 第一卷 正文第13章 考核开始第一卷 正文第14章 附加考核
content_zh:
赵松柏三人相互望了望。
旋即，星辰学宫外门长老李延鹤，大手一挥，卷起一道狂风，挡住了楚山的灵气掌印。
“学宫考核结束前，任何人不得对考核者动手！”李延鹤开口道，声音传遍整个中央广场。
“怪不得，楚凌天要把生死对决的日子定在今天，原来打的是这个主意！此子好深的心计！”楚山眼中寒芒爆闪，对楚凌天的杀意愈发强烈。
他抬头望向李延鹤，辩解道：“李长老，我乃风云城楚家分支的家主，楚凌天并不是我楚家派出的考核者。”
“生死对决开始前，我就已经强调过了。这场生死对决不光是我与楚浩辰的私怨，还关系着风云城楚家分支的学宫考核名额。谁赢，谁就是楚家分支的第一天才，可以代表风云城楚家分支，参加今日的学宫考核。”楚凌天开口道。
李延鹤微微点了点头，认可了楚凌天所说的话。
楚凌天和楚浩辰在生死对决前的对话，围观众人全都听到了。楚浩辰亲口承认，谁赢谁就是楚家分支第一天才。
李延鹤望向楚山，漠然道：“楚家主若是再对考核者动手，就别怪本长老不客气了。”
说着，他轻轻一跺脚，一股骇人的威势轰然爆发，席卷整个中央广场。
虽然他的修为不如赵松柏，但作为星辰学宫的外门长老，他的修为达到了大灵师五重天，对付楚山绰绰有余。
楚山感受到李延鹤的态度，只能选择停手。
“楚凌天，就让你代表楚家分支参加学宫考核又如何，只不过是让你多苟活一会儿罢了。等你被淘汰了，本家主定要你死无葬身之地！”楚山盯着楚凌天，杀意沸腾地说道。
学宫考核每年都会举行，每次考核的内容大同小异。他确信，楚凌天绝对无法通过考核。
楚凌天嘴角勾起一抹细微的弧度，并没有回应楚山。因为事实胜于雄辩，考核结果会替他狠狠扇楚山的脸。
石台上，赵松柏扫视了一圈，朗声道：“学宫考核正式开始，请所有考核者登上石台。”
话音落下，除了楚凌天之外，还有七人登上石台。
这七人，来自于风云城其他七大豪族。与楚凌天年纪相仿，最大的不过十七岁，修为最弱的，也达到了灵者八重天后期。
这是因为，学宫考核有两条规则。
第一，只针对十八岁以下的修士。

第二，考核者的修为，必须在灵者八重天后期以上。
不符合两条规则者，没有资格参加学宫考核。
所有考核者到位后，赵松柏介绍规则道：“本次学宫考核，共分为两项。第一项为为资质考核，根据考核者的血脉等级评分，一品血脉得一分，二品血脉得两分，三品血脉得三分，以此类推……”
“第二项为悟性考核，根据考核者的修炼武技情况评分。将黄阶高级武技，修炼至小成之境得一分，修炼至中成之境得两分，修炼至大成之境得三分，以此类推……”
“两项考核分数相加，达到六分以上者，则通过考核。哦，对了，除了两项考核外，还有一个附加考核。如果你们当中，有人是炼丹师、炼器师的话，可以额外加分。”
关于附加考核，赵松柏并没有报多少希望。
因为，风云城只是流云郡内的一座小城罢了。风云城各大豪族的子弟，资质普遍较低，忙着修炼功法、武技，时间都不够用，极少有人能分出时间，来修炼炼丹之道、炼器之道。
“现在开始考核！”
只见赵松柏大手一挥，从储物戒指中，取出一个两米高的水晶碑。
content_en:
Zhao Songbai and the other three looked at each other.
Immediately, Li Yanhe, the elder of the outer sect of Xingchen Academy, waved his hand and whipped up a strong wind, blocking Chu Shan's spiritual energy palm print.
"No one is allowed to touch the examiner before the academy examination is over!" Li Yanhe said, his voice spreading throughout the central square.
"No wonder Chu Lingtian decided to set the day for the life-and-death showdown today. It turned out to be this idea! This guy has such a deep scheming!" Chu Shan's eyes flashed with cold light, and his murderous intention towards Chu Lingtian became even stronger.
He looked up at Li Yanhe and argued: "Elder Li, I am the head of the Chu family branch in Fengyun City. Chu Lingtian is not the examiner sent by my Chu family."
"I have emphasized this before the life-and-death showdown started. This life-and-death showdown is not only a personal grudge between me and Chu Haochen, but also related to the place for the Chu family branch's academy assessment in Fengyun City. Whoever wins will be the top genius of the Chu family branch and can represent the Chu family branch in Fengyun City to participate in today's academy assessment." Chu Lingtian said.
Li Yanhe nodded slightly, acknowledging what Chu Lingtian said.
The conversation between Chu Lingtian and Chu Haochen before the life-and-death showdown was heard by all the onlookers. Chu Haochen personally admitted that whoever wins will be the number one genius in the Chu family branch.
Li Yanhe looked at Chu Shan and said indifferently: "If the Chu family master attacks the examiner again, don't blame me for being rude."
As he spoke, he lightly stamped his foot, and a terrifying power suddenly erupted, sweeping across the entire central square.
Although his cultivation level is not as good as Zhao Songbai's, as an outer elder of Xingchen Academy, his cultivation level has reached the fifth level of the Great Spirit Master, which is more than enough to deal with Chu Shan.
Chushan felt Li Yanhe's attitude and could only choose to stop.
"Chu Lingtian, it doesn't matter if I let you represent the branch of the Chu family to participate in the academy examination, it's just to let you live a little longer. When you are eliminated, the master of this family will make sure you die without a burial place!" Chu Shan stared at Chu Lingtian and said with murderous intent.
The Academy Assessment is held every year, and the content of each assessment is similar. He was convinced that Chu Lingtian would never pass the test.
The corner of Chu Lingtian's mouth curled up slightly, but he did not respond to Chu Shan. Because facts speak louder than words, the assessment results will slap Chushan hard on his face.
On the stone platform, Zhao Songbai glanced around and said loudly: "The Academy Examination has officially begun. All examinees are invited to step on the stone platform."
After the words fell, seven people besides Chu Lingtian boarded the stone platform.
These seven people come from the other seven wealthy families in Fengyun City. They are similar in age to Chu Lingtian, the oldest is only seventeen years old, and the weakest one has reached the late eighth level of spiritual realm.
This is because there are two rules for the academy assessment.
First, it is only for monks under the age of eighteen.
Second, the assessor’s cultivation level must be above the late eighth level of the Spiritual Realm.
Those who do not meet the two rules are not eligible to participate in the academy assessment.
After all the assessors were in place, Zhao Songbai introduced the rules: "This academy assessment is divided into two items. The first is the qualification assessment. According to the assessor's bloodline level, the first-grade bloodline is worth one point, the second-grade bloodline is worth two points, the third-grade bloodline is worth three points, and so on..."
"The second item is the comprehension assessment, which is scored based on the assessor's martial arts training. For yellow-level advanced martial arts, one point will be awarded for practicing to the realm of small achievement, two points for practicing to the realm of medium achievement, three points for cultivating to the realm of great achievement, and so on..."
"If the scores of the two assessments are added up and reach six or more points, they will pass the assessment. Oh, by the way, in addition to the two assessments, there is also an additional assessment. If any of you are alchemists or weapon refiners, you can get extra points."
Regarding the additional assessment, Zhao Songbai did not have much hope.
Because Fengyun City is just a small city in Liuyun County. The children of the major wealthy families in Fengyun City generally have low qualifications. They are busy practicing exercises and martial arts, and there is not enough time. Very few of them can spare time to practice.The way of refining elixirs and the way of refining weapons.
"Start the assessment now!"
Zhao Songbai waved his hand and took out a two-meter-high crystal tablet from the storage ring.
